findings.title: Reverse sort breaks chronological order
findings.body: The function now returns entries in descending order by `entry.at`, but the docstring states the postings should be in the order the statement lists them (ascending). This breaks the documented contract and will likely cause downstream consumers to display entries in the wrong order.

summary.problem: The change reverses the sort order of account entries, breaking the documented chronological order.
summary.done_well: The implementation remains concise and leverages Python's built-in sort.
